functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_section_lifecycle_command(p_mutation_id text, p_device_id text, p_command text, p_section_id text, p_archive_date date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_client_updated_at bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin
      if auth.uid() is null then raise exception using errcode='42501',message='Authentication required'; end if;
      perform rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle(auth.uid());
      return rakeezx.apply_sync_v2_section_lifecycle_command_before_student_0029(p_mutation_id,p_device_id,p_command,p_section_id,p_archive_date,p_client_updated_at); end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.sync_v2_field_map(p_entity text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select case p_entity
when 'score_subitems' then '{"distribution_origin_id":"configuration","item_id":"identity","name":"name","value":"configuration","order":"order","distribution_version":"configuration","start_date":"configuration","due_date":"configuration","late_points":"configuration"}'::jsonb
when 'score_subitem_completions' then '{"student_id":"identity","subitem_id":"identity","checked":"state","completion_state":"state"}'::jsonb
when 'assignments' then '{"teaching_id":"identity","lesson_id":"identity","item_id":"identity","title":"content","assigned_date":"dates","due_date":"dates","max":"grading"}'::jsonb
when 'submissions' then '{"student_id":"identity","assignment_id":"identity","status":"content","score":"content","note":"content"}'::jsonb
else rakeezx.sync_v2_field_map_before_n71(p_entity) end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.sync_v2_natural_key(p_entity text, p_record jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when p_entity='calendars' and p_record->>'preset_id' is not null
    and p_record->>'year_id' is not null then pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(
      p_record->>'year_id',coalesce(p_record->>'source','custom'),p_record->>'preset_id')
    else rakeezx.sync_v2_natural_key_before_n58(p_entity,p_record) end;
$function$

lifecycleDelegates.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle_statement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null then perform rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle(auth.uid()); end if;
  return null;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rakeezx.lock_student_lifecycle(p_owner uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_owner::text||':student-lifecycle-safety',0));
$function$

checks.name: hosted_absence_and_owner_metadata
checks.evidence: N122 migration history empty; kind/term columns absent; teaching_id NOT NULL; owner RLS/force-RLS and academic FK present; anon/authenticated/service_role remain NOLOGIN.

checks.name: n122_hosted_preimage_preserves_student_lifecycle_entry_guard
checks.evidence: Live public lifecycle RPC body c97cc4db769bd3c590cf161172b136e6 explicitly acquires lock_student_lifecycle(auth.uid()) before delegating to _before_student_0029. The exact authorized migration replaces that public wrapper with the old lifecycle body without that lock; it acquires section/row locks first. Existing statement trigger does not preserve the RPC entry lock ordering.

checks.name: n122_exact_hosted_schema_service_readback_before_product_release
checks.evidence: Stopped before apply_migration. Immutable source authority does not permit silently repairing/removing an existing guard. No tool refusal or hosted drift is claimed.

blocker.reason: Source/preimage incompatibility: the immutable qualified source would remove the existing public lifecycle entry mutex wrapper. Prior six native gates did not certify entry-lock preservation.
blocker.retryCondition: Parent authorizes corrected exact source that preserves the 0029 wrapper/early owner mutex and affected native guard qualification, then binds its new SHA for the same-session hosted phase.
